name: Demand-to-float relative selection
hypothesis: Buy candidates with rising independent net demand relative to conservatively estimated economic float after price confirmation.
spec: Setup: Comparable demand may have different effects relative to verifiable tradable float. Entry: Buy candidates with rising independent net demand relative to conservatively estimated economic float after price confirmation. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit on demand decay, float uncertainty, or trend failure. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs hedgeable short legs or float estimates for memecoins
